en.title: Mandate
en.subtitle: Every work item should be able to say who authorised it, in which document, and when — and whether that still holds.
en.loadFailed: Could not read the evidence chain
en.emptyUnknown: No evidence chain at all — by rule, no score and no findings.
en.emptyOk: No criterion hit — this work can account for its own evidence.
en.unknownNote: Missing scopes are listed above. Nothing here is inferred from absence.
en.currentHeadline: The approval still covers this work
en.currentReason: The record has been re-confirmed after its last change.
en.currentReasonJira: The approval has been re-confirmed since it was granted.
en.staleReasonJira: This approval was granted {n} days ago; nobody has re-confirmed it since.
en.staleHeadline: This approval is out of date
en.staleReason: The record changed {n} days ago; nobody has re-confirmed it since.
en.contestedReason: {n} decision records cover this work with different owners.
en.missingReason: No linked decision record or goal — the reason lives nowhere.
en.unknownReason: The decision page metadata is not available; this is not the same as clean.
en.noActionBody: This work can account for its own evidence.
en.staleAction: Ask {owner} to re-confirm this approval; a fresh confirmation is what makes it count again ({n} days since it was granted).
en.missingAction: Add an approval record: who approved, what was approved, and when — all three are required.
en.contestedAction: Decide which record governs, then explicitly retire the other.
en.staleWhy: the approval itself is {n} days old; re-confirm it before relying on it.
en.missingWhy: there is no approval record; the absence of evidence is the finding.
en.contestedWhy: more than one record claims this work; the conflict is the finding.
en.unknownWhy: the approval record could not be read; no score, rather than a clean one.
en.unknownAction: Restore access to the decision page, the goal link, and the review trace, then recompute. No score is not the same as clean.
en.checksNote: Score is the sum of counted checks. Unknown checks never become points.
en.projectSubtitle: Debt across this project, ranked so you can start at the top — coverage is printed first, because an uncovered item is not a clean one.
en.projectEmpty: No countable work items came back — nothing here is inferred from absence.
en.scanCapped: {f} of {r} scanned · REST caps at {cap} per load
en.confirmNotRead: confirmations not read in a scan
en.scanMore: more work items exist than this page shows

E_SCOPE.title: Permission not granted
E_SCOPE.body: This item maps to a page the app is not allowed to read. Until the scope is granted, the finding stays suppressed rather than guessed.

E_TIMEOUT.title: The evidence chain did not answer in time
E_TIMEOUT.body: Snapshot-level data is still shown. Open the source page directly to keep going.

E_RATE_LIMIT.title: Rate limited
E_RATE_LIMIT.body: One automatic retry already ran. Use the snapshot layer and press Recompute shortly.

E_SERVER.title: The platform returned a temporary error
E_SERVER.body: One automatic retry already ran. This does not mean your data is wrong.

E_PARSE.title: The mandate cannot be parsed
E_PARSE.body: The page may have been archived or moved. This does not mean there never was a mandate.

E_PARTIAL.title: Only part of the evidence chain came back
E_PARTIAL.body: Unconfirmed items are marked unknown and no finding is raised from them.

E_UNKNOWN_ISSUE.title: Work item not found
E_UNKNOWN_ISSUE.body: Check that the issue key is correct.

E_UNKNOWN_PROFILE.title: Unknown lens
E_UNKNOWN_PROFILE.body: Available lenses are software / launch / portfolio. Pick one and recompute.

E_WRITE_DENIED.title: No write permission
E_WRITE_DENIED.body: Read-only mode: findings can still be read and copied; the trace button is hidden.

E_WRITE_UNVERIFIED.title: The trace was written but not readable back
E_WRITE_UNVERIFIED.body: The comment may exist but the read-back did not see it. Open the issue comments before pressing again — a duplicate trace is worse than a missing one.

default.title: Could not read the evidence chain
default.body: Nothing here is inferred from absence.

en.partialNote: † missing criteria — “partial” means under half the weight could be judged; hover the number to see which

zh.title: Mandate · 决策台账
zh.subtitle: 每条工作项都应当能说出是谁、在哪份文档、什么时候授权了它——以及今天是否仍然成立。
zh.emptyUnknown: 依据链一条都没拿到——按规则不出分，也不报问题。
zh.emptyOk: 没有命中的判据——这项工作能说清自己的依据。
zh.unknownNote: 缺哪些 scope 已列在上面；这里不从「没看到」推任何结论。
zh.currentHeadline: 这份授权仍然覆盖当前工作
zh.currentReason: 最后一次修改之后，已经有人重新确认过。
zh.currentReasonJira: 这项授权批准之后，已经有人重新确认过。
zh.staleReasonJira: 这项授权在 {n} 天前批准，之后没有人重新确认。
zh.staleReason: 依据记录在 {n} 天前被改过，之后没有人重新确认。
zh.contestedReason: 有 {n} 份依据记录覆盖同一项工作，负责人不同。
zh.missingHeadline: 这项工作没有任何授权
zh.missingReason: 没有关联依据记录，也没有关联目标——为什么做，没有任何记录。
zh.unknownReason: 依据记录的元数据没有回来；这不等同于「干净」。
zh.noActionBody: 这项工作能说清自己的依据。
zh.staleAction: 请 {owner} 重新确认这项授权；只有新的确认才能让它重新算数（距今 {n} 天）。
zh.missingAction: 补一条授权记录：谁批准、批准了什么、什么时候——三项缺一不可。
zh.contestedAction: 先确认哪份记录算数，再把另一份明确作废。
zh.staleWhy: 授权记录本身就是 {n} 天前的；在依赖它之前，先重新确认。
zh.missingWhy: 没有任何授权记录；缺少证据本身就是结论。
zh.contestedWhy: 不止一份记录同时指向这项工作；冲突本身就是结论。
zh.unknownWhy: 读不到授权记录；宁可不出分，也不当作干净。
zh.unknownAction: 恢复依据页、目标链接与复核痕迹的访问，然后重新计算。不出分不等于干净。
zh.checksNote: 分数是已计入判据之和；未判的判据永远不会变成分数。
zh.projectSubtitle: 整个项目的债，按从重到轻排好，先看第一条——覆盖率印在最前面，因为「没覆盖到」不等于「干净」。
zh.projectEmpty: 没有取到可计入的条目——这里不从「没看到」推任何结论。
zh.scanCapped: 本次扫描 {f}/{r} 条 · REST 降级每次上限 {cap} 条
zh.scanMore: 该项目还有未显示的条目

E_SCOPE.title: 缺少授权
E_SCOPE.body: 这条工作指向一份应用无权读取的页面。在 scope 授予之前，判据会保持「不可知」，而不是猜一个结论。

E_TIMEOUT.title: 依据链没有按时返回
E_TIMEOUT.body: 快照层信息仍在；直接点开原文即可继续判断。

E_RATE_LIMIT.title: 接口限流
E_RATE_LIMIT.body: 已自动重试一次。先看快照层，稍后再点「重新计算」。

E_SERVER.title: 平台侧临时错误
E_SERVER.body: 已自动重试一次。这不代表你的数据有问题。

E_PARSE.title: 依据页无法解析
E_PARSE.body: 页面可能已归档或被移动。这不等于「从来没有依据」。

E_PARTIAL.title: 只拿到部分依据链
E_PARTIAL.body: 未确认的条目标记为不可知，不会据此报问题。

E_UNKNOWN_ISSUE.title: 找不到这项工作
E_UNKNOWN_ISSUE.body: 请确认工作项 key 是否正确。

E_UNKNOWN_PROFILE.title: 未知口径
E_UNKNOWN_PROFILE.body: 可用口径为 交付 / 发布营销 / 组合治理，切换后重新计算即可。

E_WRITE_DENIED.title: 没有写入权限
E_WRITE_DENIED.body: 只读模式：仍可查看与复制结论，留痕按钮已隐藏。

E_WRITE_UNVERIFIED.title: 留痕写了，但读不回来
E_WRITE_UNVERIFIED.body: 评论可能已存在，但回读没看到它。再点一次之前先去工作项评论里确认——重复的留痕比缺失的更糟。

default.title: 读不到依据链
default.body: 这里不从「没看到」推任何结论。

zh.partialNote: † 缺判据——「判据不足」表示可判权重不到一半；悬停分数可看缺哪几条
